verdict.rationale: Recurly has a documented developer API with official client libraries in seven languages (Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP, Go). Its change-subscription docs cover updating plan, price, quantity and add-ons with control over timing and proration, but they don't explicitly say these changes are made through the API. The pack shows the update step of the lifecycle and an API surface, but nothing directly evidences create, pause or cancel via API. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for creating, pausing/resuming and cancelling subscriptions, confirmation that subscription changes are exposed via the API rather than only the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free lifecycle.
